info.title: Plugin Service
info.description: Manages the OnePlatform plugin registry. Plugins extend the platform with custom connectors, transformers, destinations, auth providers, and widgets. Includes installation, instance management per tenant, versioned upgrades with drain-based rollouts, and hook chain resolution.

tags.name: Plugins
tags.description: Plugin registry management. Installation and uninstallation require the platform-admin role.

tags.name: Plugin Instances
tags.description: Per-tenant plugin instances. Creating an instance enables the plugin for a specific tenant with custom configuration.

tags.name: Plugin Upgrades
tags.description: Versioned upgrade and rollback for installed plugins. Requires platform-admin role.

tags.name: Plugin Hooks
tags.description: Hook chain query for a plugin at a specific lifecycle stage.

post.description: Installs a plugin from a signed .oppkg bundle. The request must be multipart/form-data with a 'bundle' file field. If the manifest declares external URLs and approveUrls is false, the installation is paused and returns 202 with a list of URLs requiring approval. Resubmit with approveUrls=true to proceed. Requires platform-admin role.
